novel_features.name: Listing hygiene + GPSR audit
novel_features.description: Find every listing with missing tags, materials, alt text or photos, or missing GPSR manufacturer/responsible-person data, in one offline pass.
novel_features.rationale: Requires scanning every synced listing and image plus a join against synced economic operators, which no single API call returns.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this before bulk edits or the 2027-02-01 GPSR deadline instead of paging every listing live. Needs `etsy-pp-cli auth login`, ETSY_SHOP_ID and a prior `etsy-pp-cli sync`. `--plan-out plan.json` writes a plan that `listings bulk-edit --plan plan.json` previews.

novel_features.name: Fee breakdown
novel_features.description: See what Etsy charged you, by fee type, for any period.
novel_features.rationale: Aggregates synced payment-account ledger entries locally; the API only returns raw entries.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use for fee and cost questions without spending API quota. Needs `etsy-pp-cli auth login`, ETSY_SHOP_ID and a prior `etsy-pp-cli sync`. (ledger needs the transactions_r scope)

novel_features.name: Ledger reconcile
novel_features.description: Find receipts, payments and ledger entries that don't line up, by id and amount.
novel_features.rationale: Joins three synced tables and checks running-balance continuity, impossible from one endpoint.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use when payouts or refunds look wrong, before opening Etsy support. Needs `etsy-pp-cli auth login`, ETSY_SHOP_ID and a prior `etsy-pp-cli sync`. Notes name any family that was never synced.

novel_features.name: Renewal planner
novel_features.description: List active listings expiring soon and whether they auto-renew.
novel_features.rationale: Filters the synced catalog by ending time locally across every listing.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use to plan renewal fees and avoid listings silently going inactive. Needs `etsy-pp-cli auth login`, ETSY_SHOP_ID and a prior `etsy-pp-cli sync`.

novel_features.name: Inventory structural audit
novel_features.description: Spot zero-quantity variations, missing or duplicate SKUs and price spread across variations.
novel_features.rationale: Walks every synced product and offering, which would take one live call per listing.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use for variation and SKU data quality; use inventory low-stock for a reorder list. Needs `etsy-pp-cli auth login`, ETSY_SHOP_ID and a prior `etsy-pp-cli sync`.

novel_features.name: Dead-weight listings
novel_features.description: Find active listings with no sales in a window, with favorite counts.
novel_features.rationale: Joins synced listings to synced transactions; no API aggregate exists.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use to decide what not to renew or to rework. Needs `etsy-pp-cli auth login`, ETSY_SHOP_ID and a prior `etsy-pp-cli sync`. Returns [] with a note when transactions were never synced (unknown is not zero).

novel_features.name: Shop attention feed
novel_features.description: One compact summary of what needs attention: unshipped orders, expiring listings, audit findings, reconcile mismatches and sync age.
novel_features.rationale: Composes several local-store queries into one object with zero live calls.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Agents should call this first for a daily check instead of polling the API. Needs `etsy-pp-cli auth login`, ETSY_SHOP_ID and a prior `etsy-pp-cli sync`. Read `notes`: a 0 for a family that was never synced means unknown, not zero.

novel_features.name: Review digest
novel_features.description: Rating histogram, low-rated reviews and per-listing averages for a period.
novel_features.rationale: Aggregates synced reviews locally; the API returns pages of raw reviews.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use to catch product problems surfacing in reviews. Needs ETSY_SHOP_ID and a prior `etsy-pp-cli sync` (the default sync includes reviews; works with the API key alone; no OAuth).

novel_features.name: Market snapshot
novel_features.description: Capture a dated snapshot of the listings and shops that appear for your search terms.
novel_features.rationale: Stores every result position, listing and shop from repeated public searches into the local store, which no single API call keeps.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Start any market or competitor question here; the other market commands read its stored snapshots. Uses only the API key. Each search page can cost up to 1 + --per-page calls (101 at the default) against the 5,000/day quota; use --per-page 25 for a cheaper scan, and --with-reviews when you need demand.

novel_features.name: Market trend
novel_features.description: See which listings and shops entered or left, and how prices, favorites and positions moved, between two snapshots.
novel_features.rationale: Diffs two stored snapshots; Etsy has no history endpoint.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use when asked how a niche changed over time. Needs two complete snapshots; with fewer it returns [] plus a note.

novel_features.name: Demand proxy
novel_features.description: Rank listings and search terms by recent review volume and shop sales, with an explicit can't-tell result for thin data.
novel_features.rationale: Combines windowed review counts and shop sales totals across a snapshot; the API exposes no per-listing sales.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use to estimate which products sell best without third-party tools. Needs a snapshot taken with `--with-reviews`; otherwise every listing reports `absent` (no review data, not zero).

novel_features.name: Competitor shops and crowd-out
novel_features.description: Profile the shops behind a snapshot and see whether big shops crowd out new ones.
novel_features.rationale: Joins snapshot listings to shop sales, age and listing counts locally.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use to size up competitors in a niche. Reads the latest complete market snapshot.

novel_features.name: Gap finder
novel_features.description: Find targets where no matching listing was found in the pages and terms you searched, with coverage checked against known competitors.
novel_features.rationale: Classifies every snapshot listing with your rule file and reports coverage-qualified gaps.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use to find product ideas with little competition, stated as what was searched. Needs a prior market snapshot and a --rules YAML file of targets.

novel_features.name: Tag and title-word contrast
novel_features.description: See which tags and title words the best-selling listings use that the rest don't.
novel_features.rationale: Compares tag frequency between demand quartiles in the snapshot; tags are not visible in search pages.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use when writing titles and tags for a new listing. Reads the latest snapshot; ranks by review demand when collected, otherwise by search position (reported in `basis`).

novel_features.name: Price bands
novel_features.description: Price ranges per category and whether price tracks demand.
novel_features.rationale: Computes ranges and rank correlation per group from snapshot data.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use when pricing a new product against the market. Reads the latest snapshot; the price-vs-demand correlation is null unless the snapshot used --with-reviews.

narrative.headline: Etsy Open API v3 commands plus a local SQLite store for offline fee reports, ledger reconciliation, listing and GPSR audits, market research, and previewed bulk edits.
narrative.value_prop: Log in, set ETSY_SHOP_ID, run `etsy-pp-cli sync`, then answer fulfilment, money and catalog questions offline with `money fees`, `money reconcile`, `listings audit --rules gpsr`, `listings expiring`, `inventory audit` and `orders unshipped`. Public market research (`market snapshot`, then `market shops`, `gaps`, `tags`, `price`) needs only the API key. The default login is read-only; writes need `auth login --all-scopes` and an explicit `--yes`, and `listings bulk-edit` previews every change until `--apply --yes`.
narrative.auth_narrative: Every request sends `x-api-key: <keystring>:<shared_secret>` (required by Etsy since 2026-02-09): set ETSY_API_KEY to your keystring and ETSY_SHARED_SECRET to your shared secret from etsy.com/developers/your-apps, or put both in ETSY_API_KEY as `keystring:secret`. `etsy-pp-cli app ping` confirms Etsy accepts the key. Public data (active listings, shops, reviews, taxonomy, market snapshots) needs only that header. Shop data (orders, money, drafts, inventory) also needs `etsy-pp-cli auth login` (OAuth 2.0 PKCE) and ETSY_SHOP_ID set to your shop id. The default login is read-only (listings_r shops_r transactions_r); `auth login --all-scopes` adds email_r, write, delete, address and profile scopes. If your app registers an https redirect, use the two-step flow: `auth login --redirect-uri <url>` prints the authorize URL, then `auth login --callback-url '<redirected url>'` finishes it. Access tokens last 1 hour and refresh automatically for 90 days.

quickstart.comment: Checks config and credentials without calling the network.
Confirms Etsy accepts your keystring:shared_secret (a 403 means a missing or mismatched secret, or an inactive app).
Reports the key format, today's remaining quota, and whether an OAuth session is present.
After auth login and ETSY_SHOP_ID, mirrors your shop once so every report after this is free.
One summary of what needs attention today.

troubleshoots.symptom: 403 "API key not found or not active, or incorrect shared secret"
troubleshoots.fix: Set ETSY_SHARED_SECRET (or ETSY_API_KEY=keystring:secret) and confirm the app is active at etsy.com/developers/your-apps; then run `etsy-pp-cli doctor`.
Wait for the retry-after seconds the CLI prints; use local commands after `sync` instead of repeated live calls.

troubleshoots.symptom: 403 on orders, ledger or write commands
troubleshoots.fix: Check granted scopes with `etsy-pp-cli app token-scopes`; for writes, log in again with `etsy-pp-cli auth login --all-scopes`.
Run `etsy-pp-cli sync --since 7d` to refresh the local store.

troubleshoots.symptom: Shop commands return nothing after sync
troubleshoots.fix: Set ETSY_SHOP_ID to your shop id and run `etsy-pp-cli auth login`; sync skips shop data with a hint when either is missing.

narrative.when_to_use: Use this CLI for an Etsy seller's shop operations: whole-catalog audits, fee and payout questions, the unshipped-orders queue (`orders unshipped`), low stock (`inventory low-stock`), and previewed bulk edits (`listings bulk-edit`). Shop reports need `auth login`, ETSY_SHOP_ID and a prior `sync`; market research needs only the API key and a prior `market snapshot`. It is the right choice when an agent needs answers across many listings or orders without spending API quota or risking rate-limit bans.
anti_triggers: Do not use it to buy on Etsy or manage a buyer cart or favorites; the v3 API has no buyer cart endpoints.
Do not use it for Etsy Ads, Marketplace Insights or Offsite Ads stats; those are not in Open API v3.
Do not use it for high-frequency monitoring or polling; Etsy bans apps for it.

recipes.title: Daily shop check for an agent
recipes.explanation: One local-store summary instead of many live calls.

recipes.title: Fees by type last month
recipes.explanation: Groups synced ledger entries by fee type.

recipes.title: GPSR readiness before the deadline
recipes.explanation: Lists only the listings and missing GPSR fields. Shop commands wrap rows as {results, notes}, so --select paths start with results.

recipes.title: Renewal planning
recipes.explanation: Soonest-expiring active listings and their auto-renew setting.

recipes.title: Market snapshot then demand
recipes.explanation: Capture public search results with review dates once, then run market demand, shops, tags and price offline (market gaps also needs a --rules file).

recipes.title: Audit, then preview a bulk fix
recipes.explanation: Preview-only: shows every proposed change. For a large fix, run `listings audit --plan-out plan.json` (add --force to overwrite) and preview it with `listings bulk-edit --plan plan.json`. Nothing is sent until --apply --yes (needs auth login --all-scopes); `--resume JOB` continues an interrupted job.

what do competitors charge on etsy
